horoscopes.intro: November 3 in the stars: Find out what’s in store for you today in our daily horoscopes for Tuesday November 3. Read the daily horoscopes for your Sun sign or rising sign (ascendant) to plan your day.

aries.text: You’re intent on being of service today as the devoted Virgo moon pings the energetic Sun in transformative Scorpio. If someone you care about needs a favor, making time to help them out can have a bigger impact than you might imagine. Your can-do attitude will be infectious, empowering everyone around you to step up their game and pitch in. Whether you’re covering a shift for a coworker or dropping dinner at a friend’s door, your thoughtful act of kindness really does matter. Don’t be surprised if it circles back to you before the week is out.

taurus.text: It’s not your fault people can’t take their eyes off of you today! As the moon in your glamorous fifth house high-fives the Sun in your interpersonal seventh, you’re bound to grab the attention of everyone you cross paths with. Up the ante by posting an OOTD or publicizing your win of the week. Embrace this profile-boosting starmap by putting yourself out there with confidence and turning up somewhere you’re likely to encounter romantic prospects or industry influencers. Coupled Bulls can bond with bae by sharing straight from the heart, no filters required.

gemini.text: Today’s skies feature an opportune alliance between the moon in your cozy fourth house and the Sun in your productive sixth. If you can work from home, take the option, because you’ll cross something significant off your list without ever changing out of your slippers. Ease into the morning with your caffeine of choice and something warm to eat. After work, tackle one household project that feels doable, from assembling a bookcase to putting away your summer clothes (at last). If you could use a hand, ask a friend to swing by and let them know dinner’s on you.

cancer.text: You’re no stranger to strong emotions, Cancer. If you’re flooded with feels today, your reflex might be to duck into your shell, but try this tactic instead: be open to expressing what’s going on inside you. Your cosmic captain, the moon, is in your communication center, plus it’s joining forces with the Sun in powerful Scorpio and your heart-centered fifth house. So you have the ability to convey where you’re coming from and to get your message across loud and clear without ruffling any feathers. Give it a go!

leo.text: A beneficial moon-Sun sextile sets the stage for a moneymaking opportunity today, so stay on alert. Whether it’s a lucrative side hustle or a higher-paying position at your company, throw your hat in the ring so the decision makers know for sure that you’re interested. You gotta be in it to win it, Leo! But don’t let your innate confidence veer into hubris. Do your homework so you’re familiar with all the ins and outs of this offer. A little research can make a big difference.

virgo.text: Your words come through loud and clear today as the Virgo moon fistbumps the Scorpio Sun in your third house of cognition and communication. If you’ve been waiting for the right time to share some big news, this starmap favors going public. When you prioritize your personal fulfillment, you’re an even more formidable force. Whether you’re clearing the air with a sibling or skipping a work happy hour so you can make your yoga class, keep your needs in the equation.

libra.text: Let it go, Libra. Today, the nurturing moon in your twelfth house of surrender and healing forms a flowing sextile to the transformative Scorpio Sun. Here’s a golden opportunity to release a longstanding grudge in order to lighten your load and move on with your life. If you like the idea of letting bygones be bygones but you’re not quite there yet, try writing a letter to the offending party to get your feelings out, then leave it unsent. At least the stuck anger will be moving now rather than festering. Processing buried emotions allows you to find worthwhile lessons in painful past experiences, like how vital it is to teach people how you want to be treated.

scorpio.text: Savvy socializing is in order when the productive Virgo moon in your communal eleventh house signal-boosts the Sun in Scorpio today. Maybe you feel like you already have a list of valuable contacts at your fingertips. But some strategic networking can help you beef it up even more, so don’t be complacent under these auspicious skies. Sign up for the industry panel or say yes to the after-work drinks, then mingle with the thought leaders and potential mentors in the room.

sagittarius.text: You never know when a guardian angel will appear in an unexpected guise and open doors to your dreams. Today’s a good bet as the moon in your ambition arena high-fives the Sun in your spirit sector. Someone could step in to guide you on your path right when you needed an assist. But you need to meet the universe halfway, Archer. Pay close attention to your intuition and trust those inklings. If the hairs on the back of your neck stand up when a person nearby mentions an intriguing idea, harness your famous courage, introduce yourself and ask them to elaborate. Carpe diem!

capricorn.text: A shared adventure or cross-cultural connection could be in the cards today as the moon in your exploratory ninth house pings the Sun in your group-oriented eleventh house. Be open to a spontaneous experience that might feel like a stretch, whether that’s a weeknight lecture on a subject you know nothing about or showing a visiting colleague around town after work. If your wanderlust is on the rise, just researching an exciting trip will help scratch the itch. Even an hour with people from outside your usual orbit could shift how you’re thinking about the months ahead.

aquarius.text: Wear your heart on your sleeve today when the emo moon in your intense, intimate eighth house gets in flowing formation with the Sun in passionate Scorpio. Let your guard down and reveal something personal that you haven’t shared before. But make sure you’re in a safe space first, speaking privately to someone you trust. They might be inspired to divulge their own secrets in return. And all this bonding might just take your relationship to a deeper, more soulful level.

pisces.text: You don’t have to keep avoiding a tricky talk, Pisces. Lucky for you, the moon in your interpersonal realm is fist-bumping the Sun in your candor court today, setting the stage for honest, respectful communication. Besides, you’re probably tired of dodging the issue. Opening up will allow you to exhale at last. Bravely venture into those deep, dark waters so you can get to the heart of the matter. Small talk won’t cut it.
